epistemic_status.NOT_a_claim: That any specific latent quote surface was observed. L5's actual unfilled, resting or cancelled orders are UNOBSERVABLE_OR_UNRESOLVED in every dataset held here, and an inferred surface is NEVER to be labelled an observed L5 order.
epistemic_status.evidence_is_indirect: P1 clustering, P3 falling-side, P4 rising hazard are consequences of a surface, not sightings of one.
